classification.difficultyReason: Track the complete unknown sector around folded corners and use supplied perpendicular guides and adjacent angles.

content.prompt: Determine the size of the missing angles using supplementary angles. All outlined quadrilaterals in this question are rectangles.

spec.description: Two adjacent black rectangles and a tilted blue square share the baseline vertex. All intersecting outlines remain visible.
spec.mathematics: Upper sectors, from left to right, are 60°, a°, b°, c°. The blue incident sides enclose a marked right angle. Upright rectangular corners are visually implied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels; supplied answers excluded.

answer.worked:
Using the rectangular corners and marked right angle:
$$\begin{align*}a+60&=90\\a&=30\\a+b&=90\\30+b&=90\\b&=60\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}60+a+b+c&=180\\60+30+60+c&=180\\150+c&=180\\c&=30\end{align*}$$
$a=30^\circ,\ b=60^\circ,\ c=30^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}h+57&=90\\h&=33\\g+h&=90\\g+33&=90\\g&=57\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Black baseline and upright ray; perpendicular blue oblique rays with their source right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: Consecutive upper sectors a°, b°, 50°, c°. Upright-to-baseline perpendicularity is unmarked in the source.

answer.worked:
The marked right angle gives:
$$\begin{align*}b+50&=90\\b&=40\end{align*}$$
The marked right angle between the upright ray and baseline gives:
$$\begin{align*}a+b&=90\\a+40&=90\\a&=50\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}a+b+50+c&=180\\50+40+50+c&=180\\140+c&=180\\c&=40\end{align*}$$
$a=50^\circ,\ b=40^\circ,\ c=40^\circ$.

spec.description: Blue baseline and upright ray; black oblique ray pair with a black right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: Consecutive sectors 25°, d°, e°, f°. Blue upright-to-baseline perpendicularity is unmarked.

answer.worked:

The marked right angle gives:
$$\begin{align*}d+e&=90\\65+e&=90\\e&=25\end{align*}$$

$d=65^\circ,\ e=25^\circ,\ f=65^\circ$.

answer.worked:

$$\begin{align*}u+90+25&=180\\u+115&=180\\u&=65\\a&=u+40\\a&=65+40\\a&=105\end{align*}$$

answer.worked:

$$\begin{align*}30+90+u&=180\\120+u&=180\\u&=60\end{align*}$$
Using the given rectangular corner:
$$\begin{align*}a&=u+90\\a&=60+90\\a&=150\end{align*}$$
$a=150^\circ$.

answer.worked:
